probes.observation: Input order and exact duplicate sources do not change output digests.
Tampered source projections and conflicting duplicate source digests fail closed.
Requested runtime metadata never fills unobserved effective fields.
Durations are derived from verified timestamps and use deterministic median and nearest-rank p95.
Unknown or sensitive fields are rejected by the projection allowlist.
Semantic failure identity ignores attempt, profile, prompt, worktree, slice, base, epoch and candidate lineage.
Acceptance-group members remain separately visible, including pending members.
Resource state from any authority other than resource-lifecycle fails closed.
The run summary exports final git, attempt, slice, checkpoint, breaker, route, profile, process, Docker, lock, filesystem, install, landing and human state digests.
The compiler returns all ten versioned telemetry documents without mutating source or policy inputs.
